messages:
olivia: Hi! New joiner herestarting on infra. Trying to set up a small eval project in europe-west3 but cant see the EU billing account in the console. Also need a CMEK key and no external IPs. Who should I request access from and what exact roles do I put in the form?

linda (IT): Welcome Olivia! :wave: For billing visibility you need Billing Account Viewer or Billing Account User on the billing account and Project Billing Manager on the project. For CMEK: ask for roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on the key. For creating buckets and VMs: roles/storage.admin and roles/compute.admin (or more limited compute.networkUser + compute.instanceAdmin if you want least privilege).

olivia: Great, prefer least-priv. Can I request project-level roles only? I don't want org-level permissions. Also we need the key resource name to be accepted by infra (they enforce CMEK in org policy).

ben (eng): Recommend project-level billing.link + roles/iam.serviceAccountUser and roles/iam.serviceAccountCreator if you'll run jobs. For VPC, if we're using the shared-vpc host in EU, request compute.networkUser on the host project subnet. Linda usually needs the subnet name.

olivia: Subnet is shared-vpc-host-eu/subnet/eu-eval-1. Project number 1234509876. KMS key: projects/redwood-eu/locations/europe-west3/keyRings/eval-ring/cryptoKeys/eval-cmek. Target billing account EU-ID-7700. No GPUs, just 2 vCPUs for a test instance.

cloudops-bot: Please file an IT ticket via https://redwood.internal/it/cloud-request. Required fields: project_number, billing_account_id, kms_key_resource_id, role_list, subnet_resource (if shared VPC), justification.

linda (IT): Thanks @olivia, I'm picking this up. For the ticket put: roles/billing.user on the billing account, roles/billing.projectManager on the project, roles/storage.admin, roles/iam.serviceAccountUser, roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter (bound to the key), and roles/compute.networkUser on shared-vpc-host-eu. I'll not grant compute.admin. Also confirm you accept no external IPs (org policy) and that you want the Compute Engine default service account enabled.

maria: FYI if you need to run short ad-hoc jobs, we have a project template that pre-creates the service account and bucket with CMEK. Ping me and I can include you on it so you don't need to request every permission.

olivia: Filed ticket #IT-9022 and added justification + subnet. Please expedite if possible, evaluating datasets today. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:

linda (IT): Ticket noted, ETA 24-48h. I will update here once billing attached and roles applied.

olivia: Awesome, appreciate it!
